counter_hardware_events: not collected; no PMU access assumed
frequency_note: Apple Silicon may not expose a base clock; null means unavailable, not zero.
cache_note: Missing L3 may mean absent or unexposed; null is never treated as a measured zero.
student_id_note: The supplied ID has 9 digits; full ID used unchanged despite PDF saying 8.
normalization_note: Empty optional sysctl values are represented as JSON null; original raw_sysctl strings and all measured values retained.

false_sharing_method.allocation: RawArray(c_int64), explicitly aligned; one writer per counter; no global lock in hot loop
false_sharing_method.timing: spawn/import and readiness excluded; start signal through receipt of all completed workers included
false_sharing_method.affinity: OS scheduler; physical core placement is not guaranteed
false_sharing_method.privatization: local Python scalar incremented K times; one final write under a shared lock
false_sharing_method.warning: 64-byte spacing is not sufficient for a CPU with 128-byte coherence lines. Native padding is additionally tested when detected.
false_sharing_method.karp_flatt_warning: K is fixed PER worker, so aggregate work grows with P. The PDF literal Karp-Flatt uses T1/TP on unequal work and is not a strong-scaling serial fraction. A work-normalized throughput-based diagnostic is reported separately; neither guarantees monotonicity.
